rationale: GetWidget calls ChangeUriPlaceholder directly: a same-type, same-solution call with exactly one possible target. Must resolve to a confirmed `invokes` relation.

Ok and NotFound are calls bound to a framework callable outside the analyzed solution scope. Recorded as a counted exclusion (GCPC-016): never a confirmed `invokes`, never a candidate, never a per-occurrence diagnostic.

Interface dispatch to IOrderQueries.GetOrderStatus with a single concrete implementation (Certification.Queries.OrderQueries) in another project. Syntactically identical to a direct call, but must resolve to exactly one CandidateLink at the concrete implementation and never a confirmed `invokes` to the interface member (GCPC-018) -- the audit's dropped-invocation regression.
